verdict.rationale: GitBook documents a REST API, an official MCP server and a CLI that agents can use. None of the evidence describes issuing scoped, least-privilege or permission-limited API tokens for an agent. 'Authenticated access' covers reader access to published sites, which is a different capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
